description: Free for a PAID check: add a callback (https) that receives signed events when requiredLevel is reached, when the answer changes, when it becomes final, or when checking gives up. The service re-checks on its own.

requiredLevel.description: Proof level you need before releasing money (Base: tee_attested < zk_proven < resolved; Ethereum: finalized; XRPL: unl_quorum). The answer then says whether it is releasable.

name: watch_verification
